messages:
Mara (People Ops): New manager starts next Mon. I'm building a very short "Manager First Week" checklist + one-line 30/60/90. Need must-haves we can't forget.

Jin (HR): Must include payroll ID checklist, benefits link + deadline, manager handbook + probation timeline. Also add "manager training" slot in wk2.

Omar (IT): I'll pre-stage laptop + SSO. Common sticky point: repo admin perms. Escape hatch: if access missing >2h, ping @Omar and click "Start IT triage" in the packet.

Pri (Hiring Manager): Please include: 1) who signs the 30/60/90 (skip-level), 2) a 7-day checklist for managers (meet directs, review retros, check oncall), 3) a one-paragraph "what success looks like" for the role.

Mara (People Ops): Draft Day -2 email (48h before): attach handbook, benefits link, bring ID, confirm laptop window, link to "start IT triage". Draft Day1 agenda: 09:00 welcome + HR, 10:00 access check, 11:00 team intros, 14:00 30/60/90 sketch + skip-level check-in, 16:00 EOD with People Ops.

Jin (HR): I'll assign a benefits buddy and confirm payroll setup by Day 3. Add benefits enrollment deadline to the email.

Omar (IT): I'll add a short troubleshooting snippet for common git/ssh errors and include the ticket link once created.

Mara (People Ops): One-line 30/60/90 sheet idea (single-row per period):
- 30d: Access + team ramp (metric: 1 small PR merged)
- 60d: Own feature/ops area (metric: milestone hit)
- 90d: Deliver outcome + feedback loop (metric: stakeholder sign-off)
Keep columns: Objective | Success metric | Blockers | Sign-off.

Pri (Hiring Manager): Good. I'll DM my role success blurb to include. Can People Ops schedule a 30-min office hour about writing 30/60/90s in week1? I can co-host.

Mara (People Ops): Yes, scheduling office hour Thu week1. Owners: Omar=access, Jin=paperwork & benefits, Pri=role blurb & intros, Mara=calendar templates + packet. Onboarding Bot: please schedule Day -2, Day1, Week1 reminders.

Onboarding Bot: Reminders created: Day -2 email 48h prior, Day 1 agenda 24h prior, Week1 check-in.

Mara (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll post the final one-pager here tomorrow and include the escape-hatch zoom link. If anyone has a super-brief 30/60/90 example, drop it here. :thumbsup:
